observations.contractConclusion: REJECTED rows are unrecoverable through every client-reachable path without violating declared invariants: same-payload create re-fetches the old run; other repetitions 409 on receipt immutability; re-uploading sealed bytes to the REJECTED artifact returns 'artifact-already-bound' without re-validation (artifacts.ts:1836-1844); uploading different bytes 409s on immutable artifact metadata (artifacts.ts:1846-1848). Only an operator state mutation (requeue) or a brand-new measurement group could rescore these bytes; that is an integration/Oliver decision, not something this lane performs.
